---
title: "wrapped fixture: Word metadata width plus gap"
filters:
  - wrapped
format: docx
wrapped:
  width: 5in
  gap: 2in
---

With no reference doc the text is 9360 twips wide. The metadata width of
5in (7200 twips) plus its gap of 2in (2880 twips) fills the text, so the
document default width becomes 40% (3744 twips), with one warning.

![A figure with the document's width and gap.](plot.png){#fig-meta .wrap-right}

The figure takes 40% and the 2in gap, with no warning of its own. Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua.
